# Setup

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggridges)
library(ggalluvial)
library(forcats)

# Specify function
select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
mutate <- dplyr::mutate
rename <- dplyr::rename

# Source scripts
source("../scripts/functions/themes_palettes.R")

# Read data
metadata <- read_csv("../data/curated/metadata.csv")

# Palette
Subgroup_colors <- c(
  "Primary HIV infection"       = "#4B988F",
  "Severely impaired immunity"  = "#EABBBB",
  "More preserved immunity"     = "#C89A1B",
  "Elite controller"            = "#5A588B"
)

stratum_colors <- c(
  # Subgroup
  "Elite controller" = "#1b9e77",
  "More preserved immunity" = "#d95f02",
  "Severely impaired immunity" = "#7570b3",
  "Primary HIV infection" = "#e7298a",
  # CD4/CD8 status
  "Normal" = "#1B9E77",
  "Low" = "#CCCCCC",
  "Very low" = "#D95F02",
  # ART
  "INSTI" = "#e78ac3",
  "NNRTI" = "#a6d854",
  "Other" = "#ffd92f",
  "Untreated" = "#e5c494",
  # Backbone
  "Abacavir" = "#b3b3b3",
  "Tenofovir" = "#80b1d3"
)

# Levels
cd4cd8_levels <- c("Normal", 
                   "Low", 
                   "Very low")

Subgroup_levels <- c("Elite controller", 
                     "More preserved immunity",
                     "Severely impaired immunity", 
                     "Primary HIV infection")

art_levels <- c("Untreated", "Other", "INSTI", "NNRTI")

backbone_levels <- c("Untreated", "Other", "Abacavir", "Tenofovir")

subgroup_levels <- c(
  "Elite controller",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Primary HIV infection"
)
```

# Figure 1

## Figure 1B

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare dataset
# --------------------------------------------------

df_both <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV", Timepoint %in% c("Baseline", "Follow-up")) %>%
  mutate(
    Age_use = case_when(
      Timepoint == "Baseline"  ~ `Age (baseline)`,
      Timepoint == "Follow-up" ~ `Age (follow-up)`,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Age_use), !is.na(Subgroup)) %>%
  mutate(
    Subgroup = factor(
      Subgroup,
      levels = c(
        "Elite controller",
        "More preserved immunity",
        "Severely impaired immunity",
        "Primary HIV infection"
      )
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Calculate n per subgroup (unique individuals)
# --------------------------------------------------

subgroup_counts <- df_both %>%
  distinct(ID, Subgroup) %>%
  count(Subgroup)

subgroup_labels <- setNames(
  paste0(subgroup_counts$Subgroup, " (n=", subgroup_counts$n, ")"),
  subgroup_counts$Subgroup
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Plot density ridges
# --------------------------------------------------

density_age <- ggplot(df_both, aes(x = Age_use, y = Subgroup, fill = Timepoint)) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    alpha = 0.5,
    scale = 1.2,
    rel_min_height = 0.01,
    color = "grey20",
    size = 0.3,
    quantile_lines = TRUE,
    quantiles = 0.5,
    vline_linetype = "solid",
    vline_color   = "black",
    vline_size    = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = subgroup_labels) +
  labs(
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "HIV-1 subgroup",
    title = "Age distribution",
    subtitle = "Baseline vs follow-up samples; vertical line = median"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Baseline" = "#1f78b4",
      "Follow-up" = "#33a02c"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

density_age
```

## Figure 1C

```{r}
# Summarize counts per Subgroup × Sex
sex_summary <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Sex)) %>%
  mutate(Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = subgroup_levels)) %>%
  count(Subgroup, Sex)

# Stacked barplot
bar_sex <- ggplot(sex_summary, aes(x = Subgroup, y = n, fill = Sex)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "black",
    size = 7
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0)),
    name = "Number of individuals"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Sex distribution",
    x = "HIV-1 subgroup",
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_hiv()

bar_sex
```

## Figure 1D

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Define category levels
cd4cd8_levels <- c("Very low", "Low", "Normal")

# 2. Define subgroup order
subgroup_levels <- c(
  "Elite controller",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Primary HIV infection"
)

# 3. Classify each individual's change in CD4/CD8 status
cd4cd8_class <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(
    Subgroup, ID,
    baseline = `CD4/CD8 status (baseline)`,
    followup = `CD4/CD8 status (follow-up)`
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(baseline) & !is.na(followup)) %>%
  mutate(
    Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = subgroup_levels),
    baseline = factor(baseline, levels = cd4cd8_levels),
    followup = factor(followup, levels = cd4cd8_levels),
    change = case_when(
      as.numeric(followup) > as.numeric(baseline) ~ "Improved",
      as.numeric(followup) < as.numeric(baseline) ~ "Worsened",
      TRUE                                        ~ "Similar"
    )
  )

# 4. Summarize counts and percents per Subgroup
cd4cd8_summary <- cd4cd8_class %>%
  count(Subgroup, change) %>%
  group_by(Subgroup) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1),
    label   = paste0(n, " (", percent, "%)")
  )

# 5. Stacked barplot
bar_improvements <- ggplot(cd4cd8_summary,
                           aes(x = Subgroup, y = n, fill = change)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "black",
    size = 7
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Improved" = "#1b9e77",
      "Similar"  = "grey80",
      "Worsened" = "#d95f02"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0)),
    name = "Number of individuals"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "CD4/CD8 T-cell count status change (Baseline → Follow-up)",
    x = "HIV-1 subgroup",
    fill = "Change"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_hiv()

bar_improvements
```

## Figure 1E

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Prepare data
# -----------------------------
plot_data <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    # --- ART grouping ---
    ART_grouped = case_when(
      Subgroup == "Elite controller" ~ "Untreated",
      ART == "INSTI" ~ "INSTI",
      ART == "NNRTI" ~ "NNRTI",
      TRUE ~ "Other"  # everyone else is Other
    ),

    # --- Backbone grouping ---
    Backbone_grouped = case_when(
      Subgroup == "Elite controller" ~ "Untreated",
      str_detect(tolower(`Backbone 2`), "abacavir") ~ "Abacavir",
      str_detect(tolower(`Backbone 2`), "tenofovir") ~ "Tenofovir",
      TRUE ~ "Other"  # all non-EC or unrecognized backbones = Other
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    ID, Subgroup,
    `CD4/CD8 status (baseline)`, ART_grouped,
    Backbone_grouped, `CD4/CD8 status (follow-up)`
  ) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = Subgroup_levels),
    ART_grouped = factor(ART_grouped, levels = art_levels),
    Backbone_grouped = factor(Backbone_grouped, levels = backbone_levels),
    `CD4/CD8 status (baseline)` = factor(`CD4/CD8 status (baseline)`, levels = cd4cd8_levels),
    `CD4/CD8 status (follow-up)` = factor(`CD4/CD8 status (follow-up)`, levels = cd4cd8_levels)
  )

# -----------------------------
# Sankey / Alluvial plot
# -----------------------------
sankey_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(axis1 = Subgroup,
      axis2 = `CD4/CD8 status (baseline)`,
      axis3 = ART_grouped,
      axis4 = Backbone_grouped,
      axis5 = `CD4/CD8 status (follow-up)`,
      y = n)
) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Subgroup), width = 1/12, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_stratum(aes(fill = after_stat(stratum)), width = 1/12) +
  geom_label(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(label = paste0(after_stat(stratum), "\n(n=", after_stat(count), ")")),
    size = 3,
    lineheight = 0.9,
    fill = "black",
    color = "white",
    label.size = NA
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = stratum_colors, name = "Group") +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("Subgroup", "CD4/CD8 status (baseline)",
               "ART", "Backbone", "CD4/CD8 T-cell status (follow-up)"),
    expand = c(0.05, 0.05)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Sankey flow of HIV subcategories, CD4/CD8 status, ART, and backbones",
    subtitle = "Only Elite controllers are untreated; all others grouped as INSTI, NNRTI, or Other",
    y = "Number of individuals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  # remove legend
  theme(legend.position = "none")

sankey_plot
```

# Supplementary Figure 1

## Figure S1A

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# 1) Prepare data
# ---------------------------
df_rna <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease != "Healthy") %>%
  select(ID, Subgroup,
         `HIV-RNA (baseline)`,
         `HIV-RNA (follow-up)`) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(`HIV-RNA (baseline)`, `HIV-RNA (follow-up)`),
    names_to  = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "HIV_RNA"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = recode(Timepoint,
                       `HIV-RNA (baseline)`  = "Baseline",
                       `HIV-RNA (follow-up)` = "Follow-up"),
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("Baseline", "Follow-up")),
    Subgroup  = factor(Subgroup, levels = names(Subgroup_colors))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(HIV_RNA))

# ---------------------------
# 2) Plot
# ---------------------------
p_rna <- ggplot(df_rna, aes(x = Timepoint, y = log10(HIV_RNA))) +
  
  # reference lines FIRST (background)
  geom_hline(yintercept = log10(20),  color = "gray50", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = log10(75),  color = "gray50", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = log10(400), color = "gray50", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  
  # boxplots
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = Subgroup),
    outlier.shape = NA,
    width = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  
  # subgroup-colored paired lines
  geom_line(
    aes(group = ID, color = Subgroup),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  
  # 🔹 points on top
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Subgroup),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.1),
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  
  # facets
  facet_wrap(~ Subgroup, nrow = 1, scales = "fixed") +
  
  # colors
  scale_color_manual(values = Subgroup_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Subgroup_colors) +
  
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position  = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = NULL,
    y     = expression(log[10] * " HIV RNA (copies/mL)"),
    title = "HIV-RNA at baseline vs follow-up by HIV-1 subgroup"
  )

p_rna
```

```{r}
# 1) Prepare data

df_cd4 <- metadata %>%

    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +

  # 🔑 Apply palette

  scale_fill_manual(values = Subgroup_colors) +
  
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position  = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = NULL,
    y     = expression("CD4 T-cell count (cells/"*mu*"L)"),
    title = "CD4 T-cell count at baseline vs follow-up by HIV-1 subgroup"
  )
```

## Figure S1C

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# 1) Prepare data
# ---------------------------
df_ratio <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease != "Healthy") %>%
  select(ID, Subgroup,
         `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`,
         `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)`) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(`CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`, `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)`),
    names_to  = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "Ratio"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = recode(Timepoint,
                       `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`  = "Baseline",
                       `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)` = "Follow-up"),
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("Baseline", "Follow-up")),
    Subgroup  = factor(Subgroup, levels = names(Subgroup_colors))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Ratio))

# ---------------------------
# 2) Plot
# ---------------------------
p_ratio <- ggplot(df_ratio, aes(x = Timepoint, y = Ratio)) +
  
  # reference lines (clinical interpretation)
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, color = "gray50", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.0, color = "gray50", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  
  # boxplots
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = Subgroup),
    outlier.shape = NA,
    width = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  
  # paired lines (colored)
  geom_line(
    aes(group = ID, color = Subgroup),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  
  # points
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Subgroup),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.02),
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  
  # facets
  facet_wrap(~ Subgroup, nrow = 1, scales = "fixed") +
  
  # apply palette
  scale_color_manual(values = Subgroup_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Subgroup_colors) +
  
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position  = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "CD4/CD8 T-cell ratio",
    title = "CD4/CD8 T-cell ratio at baseline vs follow-up by HIV-1 subgroup"
  )
```

## Compilations

```{r}
# Figure 1B, 1C, and 1D together

# Remove y-axis elements from plots 2 and 3
bar_sex <- bar_sex +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )

bar_improvements <- bar_improvements +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )

# Combine plots
p_combined <- (density_age + bar_sex + bar_improvements) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# Save
ggsave("../plots/pdf/compilation/Figure_1B_1C_1D_together.pdf",
       p_combined, width = 28, height = 7)

ggsave("../plots/png/compilation/Figure_1B_1C_1D_together.png",
       p_combined, width = 28, height = 7)
```
